description: This file defines the EMICalculator interface for calculating and managing EMI-related operations in a loan portfolio, including interest schedule generation, disbursement, interest rate changes, repayments, and interest pauses.

classes.name: EMICalculator
classes.description: Interface defining methods for EMI calculation, interest schedule management, and repayment operations in a loan system.

methods.name: generatePeriodInterestScheduleModel
methods.description: Creates an interest schedule model from schedule periods generated by the schedule generator.

methods.name: generateInstallmentInterestScheduleModel
methods.description: Creates an interest schedule model from installments retrieved from the database.

methods.name: findRepaymentPeriod
methods.description: Finds the repayment period based on a due date.

methods.name: addDisbursement
methods.description: Applies disbursement to the interest model, recalculating EMI amounts from the disbursement date.

methods.name: addCapitalizedIncome
methods.description: Applies capitalized income transaction, recalculating EMI amounts from the transaction date.

methods.name: changeInterestRate
methods.description: Recalculates EMI amounts after an interest rate change.

methods.name: addRepaymentPeriods
methods.description: Adds additional repayment periods to the schedule.

methods.name: addBalanceCorrection
methods.description: Adjusts the outstanding balance for late payments or repayments.

methods.name: payInterest
methods.description: Records interest payment during a repayment transaction.

methods.name: payPrincipal
methods.description: Records principal payment during a repayment transaction.

methods.name: creditPrincipal
methods.description: Credits principal, increasing outstanding balance, creating a virtual EMI.

methods.name: creditInterest
methods.description: Credits interest, adding extra interest due, creating a virtual EMI.

methods.name: getDueAmounts
methods.description: Returns maximum due principal and interest for a specific day.

methods.name: getPeriodInterestTillDate
methods.description: Calculates total interest accrued till a specific date.

methods.name: getOutstandingLoanBalanceOfPeriod
methods.description: Returns the outstanding loan balance for a specific period.

methods.name: getOutstandingAmountsTillDate
methods.description: Provides outstanding amounts up to a specific date.

methods.name: calculateRateFactorForRepaymentPeriod
methods.description: Calculates rate factor for a repayment period.

methods.name: getSumOfDueInterestsOnDate
methods.description: Returns sum of due interests on a specific date.

methods.name: applyInterestPause
methods.description: Stops interest counting over a date range, chargeback interest continues.
